# Reveal.js 5.2.1

Selected unmodified release files from the `reveal.js` npm package, version
5.2.1, downloaded from:

https://registry.npmjs.org/reveal.js/-/reveal.js-5.2.1.tgz

Upstream: https://github.com/hakimel/reveal.js/tree/5.2.1

Included: core JavaScript, core and reset CSS, speaker-notes plugin and view,
and the upstream MIT license. Jekyll renders the Markdown, so no client-side
Markdown plugin or build dependencies are needed. The local presentation
theme lives in `assets/css/reveal-workshop.css`.
